# Sara Natour

## Overview
Sara Natour is a software developer working remotely with clients and startups. She specializes in full-stack development, Convex, and building AI Agents. She also has an Electrical Engineering background with experience in electronics design using Arduino, ESPs, and microcontrollers.

## Projects & Experience
- **Freelance / Startups**: Building software from the ground up, handling testing, frontend, and backend development.
- **Ye (业)**: A fully self-hostable web app for job applicants to track their applications, skip the line, and own their data without a middleman.
- **AI Agents**: Strong experience building and integrating intelligent AI Agents into products.
- **Electronics**: Designing and writing code for microcontrollers using Eagle, Flux, and more.

## Tech Stack
- TypeScript, JavaScript, React, NextJS, Astro
- TailwindCSS, Convex
- Python, Arduino, ESPs

- Open to new projects and well-developed opportunities.
